subject: Air freight quote request: FRA to LOS
body:
Dear Freight Team,

Could you please quote the fastest air freight option from FRA to LOS (Lagos, NG)? We will deliver the shipment to FRA ourselves, and it will be ready on 2026-11-23.

The shipment consists of 1 piece of spare parts for packaging machines, with a gross weight of 1288 kg and a volume of 8.25 cbm.

Please provide your all-in price in EUR and confirm the earliest available departure and expected arrival at LOS.

Thank you for your assistance.

Kind regards
Anna Sonnberg
Head of Purchasing and Logistics
Sonnberg Kaffeeroesterei GmbH
